trigger: Board remains at SEG=0x33800000 after read_valid_d3; PG058 review identified missing BMG primitive-output-register enable phase

files_modified.notes: Enabled DRAM_0 Use_REGCEA_Pin while retaining the primitive output register and no core output register.
Drives BMG ENA from the request and independent REGCEA from read_valid_d1; aligns response valid and byte offset at d2 and removes the ineffective d3 delay.
Models the PG058 memory-latch/output-register split: ENA updates the READ_FIRST latch and REGCEA transfers the latch to DOUTA.
Added PG058 source references, detailed BRAM edge behavior, configuration mapping, four fix alternatives, and the adopted independent-REGCEA contract.
Changed the recommendation to independent REGCEA and marked the source fix implemented but pending IP regeneration and post-implementation/board verification.

verification_required: Regenerate DRAM_0 and confirm generated XML has C_HAS_ENA=1, C_HAS_MEM_OUTPUT_REGS_A=1, C_HAS_REGCEA=1, and no core output register.
Rebuild the Verilator model and run RV tests plus srcSmoke; run only a bounded srcWithMext difftest as requested.
Run current post-implementation functional simulation long enough to observe the final SEG write and pair ENA/REGCEA/read_valid_d1/d2/DOUT with DCache requests.
Generate and program a new bitstream only after the post-implementation trace no longer shows one-word response lag.
notes: Vivado synthesis, implementation, and IP regeneration were intentionally not run in this change. rtl/soc/dram_driver.sv is a legacy path excluded from scripts/filelists/soc.f; if it is re-enabled, its DRAM_0 instance must be migrated to the REGCEA contract first.
